Chapter 225: Chapter 17 Changes In The Door To The Myriad Realms (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 225: Chapter 17 Changes in the Door to the Myriad Realms (Seeking Subscriptions)

“What?”

“Peak Master Shisan… really comes from our Dawn Star System?”

In the department, all members were dumbfounded, having indeed fantasized about this possibility.

After all, if the Dawn Star System really was the home system of Peak Master Shisan, then the entire Dawn Star System would benefit from his presence in the future.

Not to mention gaining any resource bias, at the very least, it wouldn’t be treated as a place to exploit for resources.

But everyone was clear that it was just a fantasy.

...

Just like before the lottery results are announced, nearly every citizen who has bought a ticket fantasizes about winning the jackpot.

But in reality, there’s only one winner; those fantasies were nothing more than impractical “wishful thinking.”

However, now.

Someone was telling them that the fantasy had turned into reality?

“Peak Master Shisan…”

All hearts were pounding as they immediately began to review the real information file about Peak Master Shisan sent from the Chikun Main Star.

“Peak Master Shisan, real name ‘Lin Yuan’, from Canglan Star, the champion of the last Canglan Star tournament, participated in the Seven Star Cave trials…”

“Peak Master Shisan, born on a middle-grade life planet? A mere middle-grade life planet managed to produce a genius like Peak Master Shisan?”

“It’s incredible, the file says that Peak Master Shisan participated in the last tournament at only Fourth Rank, and now he’s Sixth Rank?”

“I understand now. Before the tournament, Peak Master Shisan must have been cultivating on his own, reaching Fourth Rank in such a backward environment on a middle-grade life planet, then entered the Seven Star Cave World, received guidance from a Star Lord, and his fortunes soared…”

The numerous members of the department, looking at the information about Peak Master Shisan, were lost in wild thoughts.

“Chairman.”

Just then, one of the members looked up and noticed a burly man appearing.

“Chairman.”

Upon hearing this, the others immediately looked up, addressing the burly man with utmost respect.

In the entire Chenxi Mainstar, no one could be called “Chairman” except the dominion holder of the Dawn Association.

The Dawn Association was the most powerful force in the Dawn Star System, so much so that the entire system was named after it.

Of course, no matter how powerful the Dawn Association was, it was still a subordinate to the Red Kun Lineage, and only the orders from the Red Kun Lineage were obeyed.

“Hahaha, Peak Master Shisan really comes from our Dawn Star System?”

The face of the Chairman of the Dawn Association lit up with joy, showing none of the usual aloof demeanor of a chairman.

“Chairman, what should we do now?”

The department head couldn’t help but speak up.

In theory, apart from the big shots on the Chikun Main Star, only they knew about the real identity of Peak Master Shisan.

“What to do?”

“Let me think carefully.”

The Chairman of the Dawn Association composed himself.

He had been so excited that he had for a moment neglected how to handle this matter.

Without a doubt, having Peak Master Shisan from the Dawn Star System was a tremendous opportunity.

But no matter how great the opportunity, one must catch it properly; the Dawn Star System must seize this chance, especially to not let other forces get there first.

“This is what we’ll do.”

“I will personally go to the Chikun Main Star and make an appearance before Peak Master Shisan to congratulate him on advancing to Sixth Rank.”

The Chairman of the Dawn Association said.

Since the real identity of Peak Master Shisan had been transmitted from the Chikun Main Star, it meant that Peak Master Shisan was already on the Chikun Main Star.

“Secondly, Peak Master Shisan should still have parents and a sister on Canglan Star.”

Once he knew the real identity of Peak Master Shisan, the Chairman of the Dawn Association immediately connected to the virtual world and looked up ‘Lin Yuan’s’ basic information.

“Now, you take my guard troops and quickly go to Canglan Star and protect the Peak Master’s parents.”

The Chairman of the Dawn Association looked at the manager.

He wanted to cover all bases, as protecting the Peak Master’s family certainly couldn’t be wrong.

“Now, we can release the real identity of Peak Master Shisan.”

The Chairman of the Dawn Association didn’t dare delay, as upon receiving the documents transmitted by the Red Kun Lineage, Chenxi Mainstar had to act with utmost speed.

Naturally, as the spreader of the identity, the Chairman of the Dawn Association was the first to know the information and could prepare in advance.

…

The Dawn Star System.

The Heiyu Family’s stationed planet.

Being one of the top five forces in the Chikun Star Domain, the Heiyu Family had stationed planets in all eight star systems.

The stationed planets, which are entirely owned by the Heiyu Family, also serve as the family’s branch headquarters within that star system.

Overseeing all matters of the Heiyu Family in the Dawn Star System.

The Dawn Star System has twelve hundred thousand life planets, almost all of which have some trade and economic dealings with the Heiyu Family.

At this moment.

The matter of Peak Master Shisan’s real identity was transmitted here from Chenxi Mainstar.

Within a garden.

A man in a loose coat was leisurely lying there.

Two beautiful women were gently massaging him.

The man in the loose coat, named Heiyu Qin, was Heiyu Ao’s second uncle.

It was through Heiyu Qin that Heiyu Ao had cut off all trade ties between the Heiyu Family and Canglan Star.

“Although far from the family’s power core, at least I’m free, and not many can command me.”

Heiyu Qin was in a good mood, not every member of the Heiyu Family had ambitions to climb higher, and Heiyu Qin was quite satisfied with his status.

While Heiyu Qin was enjoying himself.

A deep voice suddenly echoed beside him.

“Heiyu Qin, come here.”

The voice, although devoid of any emotional fluctuations, obviously suppressed some anger… and fear.
